Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

May 11th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels in Frenchtown
intend to apply to the French Municipal Council
for permission to raise a Volunteer Corps.
This will be ostensibly for the same purposes
as the Volunteer Corps in the Settlement but in
reality will be used for training rebels to the
use of arms.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen sent
telegrams to Yunnan, Canton, Szechuen and Chekiang
yesterday urging these provinces to unite and
offering to assist them in any way he can.
It is reported that mines are placed
in the sea outside Woosung during the night time
to protect the forts from an attack by sea.
It is reported that General Lu Yung Ziang
intends to resign soon, as his troops are getting
out of hand and he fears that they will murder him.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年5月11日。

先生：

据报，法租界内的反叛分子拟向法国公董局申请许可，组建一支义勇队。此举表面上将与公共租界义勇队的目的相同，但实际上将用于训练反叛分子使用武器。

据报，孙中山昨日向云南、广东、四川和浙江发送电报，敦促这些省份联合起来，并表示愿尽其所能提供协助。

据报，夜间在吴淞口外海域布设水雷，以保护炮台免受海上攻击。

据报，卢永祥将军打算不久后辞职，因其部队已失控，他担心部下会杀害他。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监。

am
11/5

于5月11日录入备忘录。
副本已送交上海义勇队（S.V.C.）。
